entries.title: Continuity capture-path refactor (Steps 0-2): implementation spec
entries.current_reading: Thin spec for Steps 0-2 of docs/architecture/continuity-first-principles-evaluation.md. Step 0 ran 2026-06-07 and returned NO-GO: the capture-side satisfaction classifier does not beat recency (0.74x false-resurrection vs a 0.50x gate, over-buries 10% of open work); 58% of sessions give the deterministic scan no usable signal and the harvest is a no-model every-turn CLI. entries.title: Pooling Circuit Memory Across an Agent Swarm
entries.current_reading: Design-only proposal (not built) for pooling Circuit's per-worktree project memory across a same-machine swarm first, then a cross-machine team. Densest kernel is a re-anchored, cite-and-verify-backed pooled read projection that converts the cross-worktree write race into a grow-only set (G-Set union merge) and replicates cited-artifact bytes so foreign facts still re-verify. Stage 0 (query-rankable, corroboration-aware recall) is the read-only slice that ships value first; the query-ranking half is being built behind a recall-side flag. External arXiv citations are post-cutoff and unverified; link-check before trusting numbers.
